n1.text: Home: pickup card, 4 tiles (Book Now / Schedule / Low Fare / Customise Order), Free Ride Chance strip. The live-order strip shows only while an order is active. Grey dashed boxes = images you will generate (H1, T1–T4, F1).

n2.text: Select Vehicle: route card with Add Stop / Edit Locations, booking type, driver search radius. Selected vehicle = big card. Goods type, coupon, reward points, GST stay here in the Offers & Details card (your decision). Vehicle photos come from admin.

n3.text: Review: vehicle + time, address details, guidelines, Booking Guarantee line (only when the amount is above 0). Bottom bar: payment (Cash / Shifter Wallet / Receiver pays), View Breakup, Book button.
